subject: general
question:
What is the name of the aromatic compound in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a7c83dfc7de07492595139e5e5a8fb8391f1033c756f5eaef02d7f53511ed43.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naphthalene**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The compound shown in the image consists of **two fused benzene rings**.
 
• This structure is characteristic of naphthalene, which is a simple polycyclic **aromatic **hydrocarbon.
 
• It is a **white crystalline solid** with a characteristic **mothball-like smell**.
 
• Naphthalene is a versatile aromatic compound with a wide range of applications, particularly in **pest control, chemical synthesis, and industrial processes**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac248d8d73de50310f1a1fca965dda8df305b54cd7f851f850f6e2a227e2d298.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tropone**:

 
 
• Tropone is a **seven-membered aromatic ring** with a **ketone group**.
 
• It does not consist of fused benzene rings like naphthalene.
 
• Its structure is quite different from the one shown in the image.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c144c0fa151ef5ddb3f092cc0d47825488ff26d7e759a06d66a200ea157bc9ba.png] 
 
 
 
• **Tetrahydrofuran**:
 
 
• Tetrahydrofuran (THF) is a **five-membered ring** containing four carbon atoms and one oxygen atom.
 
• It is a cyclic ether and **does not have the aromaticity** or fused benzene rings seen in the structure provided.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d76d07594ecb25163d77984c0de533251ae1fd9ee80dd4183fb8a9ed2e51a84.png] 
 
 
 
• **Cyclohexene**:
 
 
• Cyclohexene is a **six-membered ring** with** one double bond**, making it an **unsaturated cycloalkane**.
 
• It is** not aromatic** and does not have the fused benzene rings characteristic of naphthalene.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55fc2e773a4e8ecb018934ce7c47eed8fd59145e24edbcd8098d1ed9c14f3f30.png]
